title: THE WITNESS WHO DID NOT FORGIVE
deck: A footbridge in Tarn Vale killed four, the grant that will rebuild it lapses at noon on Sunday, and the town believes it needs the signature of the one survivor who will not forgive. Illuminara can hold half a bridge in the air for a day. What she has to find is what that signature was ever supposed to mean.
shape: Six scenes across one week: the line nobody could sign; a hanger and a held span; a bench and a bad soup; a clause read aloud to the people it was written to protect; a drawing shed where the survivor changes the design; and a night when a span is eased back onto new wire and one woman crosses it first, her no intact.

scenes.title: The Line Nobody Could Sign
paragraphs: *Tarn Vale town hall · Monday, 08:40*

Mayor Cosima Arden had laid the grant papers across the council table in the order she expected to be asked about them. Illuminara read them in that order, and then in the order she preferred, which started with the signature page and worked backwards. Under clause 4.2 the town's own text had been typed in the consultant's wording: *We, the people of Tarn Vale, forgive and are reconciled with the builder of our bridge, and ask that the works proceed in that spirit.* Fourteen names stood above a blank for the fifteenth.

**Cosima Arden**  
Twelve days since the bridge went. Six until the grant lapses, Sunday at noon, and the Fund doesn't give extensions, it gives the money to the next valley. That money rebuilds the crossing and the clinic road behind it. Four hundred households. I am sorry for Ilse Marchetti's loss. I need her signature.

**Illuminara**  
Fourteen people forgave him?

**Cosima Arden**  
Twelve forgave him and two signed to be finished with it. I don't ask which. Ilse is the fifteenth because she is the only next of kin of the four still living in the valley. She spliced wire for the quarry ropeway for twenty-two years before she took the cannery's books, and she has said no to Fenn, no to me, and no to the vicar, in that order. She was polite to the vicar.
Illuminara turned to the second page. The clause required a declaration executed by the Affected Parties *as defined in Annex B*. There was no Annex B in the town's copy.

**Illuminara**  
Where is Annex B?

**Cosima Arden**  
Fenn called it boilerplate. He wrote the application. He's in the capital until Wednesday.

**Illuminara**  
Then on Wednesday I'd like to read some boilerplate. Today I'd like to see the span, meet the man who built it, and ask Ilse Marchetti a question without a pen in my hand.

**Cosima Arden**  
You can hold it? The north half?

**Illuminara**  
For a day at a time. I can't make anyone forgive anyone, and I would be ashamed of myself if I could.

scenes.title: What the Hanger Showed
paragraphs: *North abutment, Tarn footbridge · Monday, 14:10*

The north span had hung into the gorge for twelve days from its upstream hangers, its two main cables and the stubbornness of the shoring. Hangers ten and eleven on the downstream edge had failed one after the other, and the edge had dropped. Illuminara put her palm on the main cable where it left the saddle and listened with the part of her that could read force. The whole span's weight arrived in her hand as a map of who was carrying whom, and the sag that Anselm Gray's crew had been watching for twelve days stopped.

Gray was sixty-three and stood with a ledger held against his chest, the way a man holds something he expects to be asked for. Thirty metres off, behind the police tape, a woman in a blanket coat watched with her arms folded and did not come closer.

**Illuminara**  
Eight and nine are carrying what ten used to. Nine is thin. It will go before your shoring does.

**Anselm Gray**  
Cut nine first, then eight. Ropes on it.

They cut nine out of the cable clamp in four minutes and laid it on a tarpaulin. The woman crossed the tape then, ignoring the contractor completely, and knelt at the cut end the way a splicer kneels, close enough to smell the wire.
The fracture surface had two colours. Three-quarters of it was a brown crescent, old and rust-edged. The last quarter was bright and grainy, where the wire had finally given.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
That crack was a year old. It looked like a smile for a year. Seven to eleven are the same.

**Anselm Gray**  
The spring report marked seven to eleven *due, monitor*. I had it in my truck at harvest. A closure would have shut the crossing for nine days and the cannery would have lost its market week. I said after harvest. Four people were on the span on the nineteenth. That's the whole account, and the ledger has the rest.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Photograph all five, with a rule beside each, before anyone sleeves them. The pictures go to the county inquest. Not to your office.

**Anselm Gray**  
Yes. The old ledger goes with them, whatever it does to my licence.
He started to put out his hand. It was a movement he had clearly rehearsed and abandoned several times, and it stopped halfway. She did not look at it.

**Anselm Gray**  
I've put the yard and the plant behind the bond, and the bond stays open to the families whatever the inquest decides. None of this buys me anything. I'll rebuild to a design you see before the county does, and I'll be off the site when you cross.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
You'll be off it when I cross. I'll decide when.

scenes.title: A Bench at the South Footing
paragraphs: *South footing, Tarn footbridge · Tuesday, 15:30*
Ilse Marchetti sat the way splicers sit, her hands busy at nothing. She poured a cup from a dented thermos and passed it to Illuminara without asking.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
My brother's recipe. Lentils and whatever was in the drawer.
It was ferociously salty and tasted faintly of tar, and Illuminara discovered, to her considerable surprise, that she was delighted.

**Illuminara**  
This is the worst soup anyone has ever given me.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
He'd have been so pleased.

Ilse laughed once, short and astonished, and the astonishment shut her face again. Illuminara said nothing and drank the rest of it. The wind came up the gorge and the surviving main cable began to sing, a clean A with something slightly wrong underneath.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Matteo whistled the wrong part. Every time he crossed.

**Illuminara**  
What would a true record say?

**Ilse Marchetti**  
That the hangers were cracked for a year and the man knew. That Matteo Marchetti, thirty-eight, rigger, was walking to the night shift at the cannery. Jun Abara. Corrie Vance. Desmond Thule. That they were not *lost in an incident*. Their names on the new span, cut deep enough to read from the water.

**Illuminara**  
And the things you won't do?

**Ilse Marchetti**  
I won't shake his hand. I won't sit on a stage while the vicar says peace. I won't write that I forgive him in a town hall because the clinic needs a road.

**Illuminara**  
Will you sign for the bridge?
Ilse's thumb stopped on the thermos lid.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Nobody has asked me to sign for the bridge. They've asked me to sign for him.
Illuminara sat very still. It was how she heard the things that rearranged a room.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
I've wanted a bridge since the night. One a child can cross. If a page said that I agree to it, that the names go on it, that it's built the way I say, I'd have signed on Monday morning with a fountain pen.

**Illuminara**  
I don't think the sentence about forgiveness came from the Fund. I'd like to find out whose it was. I can't promise you a paper.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
I'm not asking for one. I'm asking you not to carry my no to the mayor as a yes.

**Illuminara**  
I'll carry it as exactly what you said.

scenes.title: Clause Nine
paragraphs: *Tarn Vale town hall · Wednesday, 11:00*

The Fund's programme officer was a voice on the council room's speakerphone, and the voice had spent a long career being careful. Calder Voss had sent Annex B overnight at Illuminara's request. Cosima Arden had printed it twice and underlined nothing, which for the mayor was an act of restraint.

**Illuminara**  
Mr Voss, would you read the definition of Affected Party aloud, and then of Accord, and then clause nine point one?

**Calder Voss**  
*Affected Party means the next of kin of any person killed in the failure who still resides in the Vale, and each owner of land the Works cross. The Accord is executed only when every Affected Party has signed.* Then: *Accord means the consent of each Affected Party to the Works, on the terms stated.* And nine point one: *If any Affected Party repudiates the Accord within twenty-four months of execution, the Grant is repayable in full.*

**Illuminara**  
Why every one?

**Calder Voss**  
Because the Fund won't build over a standing objection. Nine point one is the money's protection against a signature nobody meant.

**Illuminara**  
Does the Fund ask anywhere for forgiveness?

**Calder Voss**  
No. That sentence is the applicant's prose. We ask for consent to the Works.
Arden's pen had stopped moving. Nobody said Fenn's name.

**Calder Voss**  
I'll be plain, Miss Illuminara. A recorded dissent inside an accord is a flag. My board reads flags.

**Illuminara**  
What were they afraid of when they wrote nine point one?

**Calder Voss**  
Hollin Weir. A father signed at the opening ceremony with his daughter's classmates watching. Eight months later he told the newspaper he'd never meant it. The foundations were poured. We clawed the grant back and the bridge sat half built for three years.

**Illuminara**  
So the signature most likely to be repudiated is one a person gave because the whole town was standing around her. And the one least likely is a page she wrote herself, saying exactly what she does and doesn't agree to.

**Calder Voss**  
That's a good argument. It's also exactly what someone would say who wanted the grant to go through.

**Illuminara**  
It is. Check it against Hollin Weir. Ask what that father would have signed if the page had let him keep his no.
The line hissed for a while.

**Calder Voss**  
If her page is her Accord, there is nothing for her to repudiate but her own words. I can put that to my board. Schedule One: her consent to the Works as specified, to the design, the four names and the public inspection record, with her statement that she does not forgive kept in her own words, unedited, as part of the Accord. I'll send the exact wording tomorrow so she reads what her page becomes before I send it up. The board votes Friday at five and I won't promise you the vote. I need two things by noon on Friday: her consent in her own hand, and a design stamped by the county engineer, not by Mr Gray's man.

**Cosima Arden**  
That sentence was ours. The Fund never asked for it, and I let it stand because it was easy to read out.
She drew a single line through the consultant's sentence and signed her name beside it. Then she crossed the opening ceremony off the page that listed the week.

scenes.title: The Same Smile
paragraphs: *Gray's yard, drawing shed · Thursday, 19:20*

Gray stood outside the shed door by his own choice, in the cold, with his hat in his hands. Inside, Ilse spread the new drawings under the lamp and read them the way she read wire, from the cut end back.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Same wire. Same eye. Same year of smiling before it lets go.

**Illuminara**  
What would you change?

**Ilse Marchetti**  
A tell-tale. One bright strand, paint-banded, laid outside the rest so it frays first. Sleeve the eye in orange so any child can see it wear. And the ledger goes in a glass case at the bridge head, not in an office. Anyone who crosses can read what's due.

**Anselm Gray**  
That adds eleven days to the wire order and six thousand to the bill.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Then splice it here. Five hangers. I'll show your crew the lay.

**Anselm Gray**  
There's certified strand in the yard from the south approach job, mill certificates in the drawer. Enough for five if nobody wastes an inch. I'll front the lot under the bond, ahead of the grant. If the Fund walks, that's mine.

She did not look through the door. She spoke to the drawings and the crew chief heard every word, and by nine o'clock six people were laying strands on the shed floor in a pattern Ilse had demonstrated twice with her own hands and refused to demonstrate a third time. Pell, the county engineer, would pull-test a spliced sample at eight the next morning and stamp the lay or not as the sample told him. Ilse had told Gray to tell him that.
Illuminara slid a clean sheet and a pen across the table. She turned to watch the lamp and not the page; it was not hers to read until it was handed over.

The page, when Ilse pushed it back, read: *I do not forgive Anselm Gray. I do not have to. I consent to the bridge, built to the design I have seen, with hangers any child can read. Cut their names on it: Matteo Marchetti, Jun Abara, Corrie Vance, Desmond Thule. I. Marchetti.*

Beside it Illuminara laid Voss's wording, printed that afternoon. Ilse read it twice with her finger under the line: *Schedule One is the signatory's own text and forms part of the Accord. It may not be summarised, edited or paraphrased. Her consent extends to the Works as designed, the four names and the public inspection record, and to nothing else.*

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Change *her* to *my*. Otherwise it says what I said.

**Illuminara**  
That is the whole thing?

**Ilse Marchetti**  
That's the whole thing. Take it to your man. It's mine. Don't tidy it.

scenes.title: Easing the Load
paragraphs: *Tarn footbridge, north span · Friday, 22:40*

Voss's message had reached the mayor at ten past six: *Board approved 5–2, Schedule One incorporated as written. Funds released on execution.* Cosima Arden had read it twice on the bridge approach, and then, with unusual tact, put the phone in her pocket and said nothing more to anyone.

The stamped drawings had gone to the Fund at eleven that morning with Ilse's page clipped to them, Pell's stamp on the lay and the pull-test sheet behind it. Gray's crew had hung the five hangers on his own account since noon, a good six hours before a cent was promised. By night they stood in the work lights, each with its bright outer strand and its orange sleeve. Illuminara held the north span at deck height with her palm on the main cable. Pell stood at the rail with a gauge on every hanger and a load sheet on a board, and he had told the mayor in front of everyone that his signature, not Illuminara's hand, would open the bridge.

**Illuminara**  
I'm going to let it down a tonne at a time. Call each one as it takes its share.

She read each hanger as it came alive. Seven took its load and answered. Eight. Nine, the new nine, hummed so clearly that she felt it through the cable. Ten. Eleven. Pell's gauges and her voice agreed to the tonne at every hanger, and where they might not have agreed he went with the gauges. Gray's crew called the figures and a boy with a clipboard wrote them in the ledger, and at four in the morning the last tonne went across and Illuminara took her hand from the cable and nothing at all fell. Pell signed the sheet and handed it to the mayor without a word.

At ten to six Ilse Marchetti came to the south approach in her blanket coat with her thermos and nobody with her. Gray's truck was parked a hundred metres up the road with its lights off. The mayor had taken the ceremony off the programme herself. The notice board at the bridge head said only: *Open at 06:10 on the county engineer's signature. Names to be cut next week.*

Ilse walked out alone onto the first of the new deck. At midspan she stopped, put her hand on an orange sleeve, and read the chalk lettering on the rail cap: four names, written by the mason's boy in his best capitals. The wind came up the gorge. The main cable sang its A and its small mistake.
Ilse whistled the mistake, once, a half-note wrong.
Then she crossed to the north bank without turning round. Illuminara watched from the south with the last of the soup and, for once, read no force at all, and only listened.

critic_line: Illuminara discovered that Tarn Vale had confused consent to a bridge with forgiveness of the man who had knowingly delayed repairs: Ilse's unedited no became the binding accord, independent engineering made the rebuilt crossing safe, and the town gained its bridge without erasing the dead, the survivor's judgment or Gray's continuing accountability.

shared_strengths: Humane, dialogue-driven reframing: the town asked for the wrong signature. Strong characters (Ilse, the salty soup, the whistled wrong note) and a satisfying, unsentimental resolution. Mid-story grant and clause mechanics are somewhat procedural and tidy, and the antagonists resolve too cooperatively.

A morally precise, emotionally satisfying story turns bureaucratic language into genuine suspense and lets grief retain its integrity. Distinct dialogue, tactile bridgecraft, and the soup exchange humanize its ideas. The legal-procedural middle may slow some readers, and the resolution is unusually tidy, but the final crossing earns its restraint.
shared_reservations: Calder Voss: Affected Party means the next of kin of any person killed in the failure who still resides in the Vale, and each owner of land the Works cross.

translation_sl.title: PRIČA, KI NI ODPUSTILA
translation_sl.deck: Brv v Tarn Valu je ubila štiri ljudi, nepovratna sredstva za njeno obnovo pa potečejo v nedeljo opoldne; mesto verjame, da potrebuje podpis edine preživele, ki noče odpustiti. Illuminara lahko za en dan drži polovico mostu v zraku. Ugotoviti pa mora, kaj naj bi ta podpis sploh pomenil.
translation_sl.shape: Šest prizorov v enem tednu: vrstica, ki je nihče ni mogel podpisati; obešalo in zadržani razpon; klop in slaba juha; določilo, prebrano na glas ljudem, ki naj bi jih varovalo; risalnica, v kateri preživela spremeni načrt; ter noč, ko razpon spustijo na nove žice in ga prva prečka ženska, katere ne ostane nedotaknjen.

scenes.title: Vrstica, ki je nihče ni mogel podpisati
paragraphs: *Mestna hiša Tarn Vale · ponedeljek, 08:40*

Županja Cosima Arden je dokumente za nepovratna sredstva razporedila po mizi sveta v vrstnem redu, v katerem je pričakovala vprašanja. Illuminara jih je prebrala tako, nato pa še v vrstnem redu, ki ga je imela sama raje: začela je s podpisno stranjo in šla nazaj. Pod točko 4.2 je bilo lastno besedilo mesta zapisano z besedami svetovalca: *Mi, prebivalci Tarn Vala, odpuščamo graditelju našega mostu in smo se z njim spravili ter prosimo, naj dela potekajo v tem duhu.* Nad praznim prostorom za petnajsti podpis je stalo štirinajst imen.

**Cosima Arden**  
Dvanajst dni je, odkar je most popustil. Še šest dni do izteka nepovratnih sredstev, v nedeljo opoldne, Sklad pa ne podaljšuje rokov, temveč denar dodeli naslednji dolini. Ta denar obnovi prehod in cesto do klinike za njim. Štiristo gospodinjstev. Žal mi je za izgubo Ilse Marchetti. Potrebujem njen podpis.

**Illuminara**  
Štirinajst ljudi mu je odpustilo?

**Cosima Arden**  
Dvanajst mu jih je odpustilo, dva pa sta podpisala, da bi bilo tega konec. Ne sprašujem, kdo je kdo. Ilse je petnajsta, ker je edina od svojcev četverice, ki še živi v dolini. Dvaindvajset let je spajala žico za kamnolomsko žičnico, preden je prevzela knjige v konzervarni, in rekla je ne Fennu, ne meni in ne vikarju, v tem vrstnem redu. Do vikarja je bila vljudna.
Illuminara je obrnila na drugo stran. Določilo je zahtevalo izjavo Prizadetih strank, *kot so opredeljene v Prilogi B*. V mestnem izvodu Priloge B ni bilo.

**Illuminara**  
Kje je Priloga B?

**Cosima Arden**  
Fenn jo je imenoval standardno besedilo. On je napisal vlogo. Do srede je v prestolnici.

**Illuminara**  
Potem bi v sredo rada prebrala nekaj standardnega besedila. Danes bi rada videla razpon, spoznala človeka, ki ga je zgradil, in Ilse Marchetti zastavila vprašanje brez pisala v roki.

**Cosima Arden**  
Ga lahko držiš? Severno polovico?

**Illuminara**  
Po en dan naenkrat. Nikogar ne morem prisiliti, da bi komu odpustil, in sramovala bi se, če bi ga lahko.

scenes.title: Kaj je pokazalo obešalo
paragraphs: *Severni opornik, tarnvalska brv · ponedeljek, 14:10*

Severni razpon je dvanajst dni visel v sotesko na gorvodnih obešalih, dveh glavnih kablih in trmi podporne konstrukcije. Obešali deset in enajst na dolvodnem robu sta odpovedali drugo za drugim in rob se je povesil. Illuminara je položila dlan na glavni kabel, kjer je izhajal iz sedla, ter poslušala z delom sebe, ki je znal brati silo. Teža celotnega razpona je prispela v njeno roko kot zemljevid tega, kdo nosi koga, poves, ki ga je posadka Anselma Graya opazovala dvanajst dni, pa se je ustavil.

Gray je imel triinšestdeset let in je stal z evidenčno knjigo, stisnjeno ob prsi, kakor človek drži nekaj, za kar pričakuje, da ga bodo prosili. Trideset metrov stran je za policijskim trakom ženska v plašču, podobnem odeji, opazovala s prekrižanimi rokami in ni prišla bliže.

**Illuminara**  
Osem in devet nosita, kar je prej nosilo deset. Devet je stanjšano. Popustilo bo pred vašim podpiranjem.

**Anselm Gray**  
Najprej odrežite devet, nato osem. Zavarujte ga z vrvmi.

V štirih minutah so devet izrezali iz kabelske objemke in ga položili na ponjavo. Ženska je tedaj prestopila trak, povsem prezrla izvajalca in pokleknila ob odrezanem koncu, kakor poklekne spajalka žic, dovolj blizu, da je lahko zavohala žico.
Prelomna površina je bila dveh barv. Tri četrtine so tvorile rjav polmesec, star in obrobljen z rjo. Zadnja četrtina je bila svetla in zrnata, kjer je žica nazadnje popustila.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Ta razpoka je bila stara eno leto. Eno leto je bila videti kakor nasmeh. Sedem do enajst je enakih.

**Anselm Gray**  
V spomladanskem poročilu je pri sedem do enajst pisalo *zapadlo, spremljaj*. Med žetvijo sem ga imel v tovornjaku. Zaprtje bi prehod ustavilo za devet dni in konzervarna bi izgubila tržni teden. Rekel sem: po žetvi. Devetnajstega so bili na razponu štirje ljudje. To je ves obračun, preostalo pa je v knjigi.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Fotografirajte vseh pet, ob vsakem naj bo merilo, preden kdo namesti tulce. Slike gredo v okrožno preiskavo. Ne v vašo pisarno.

**Anselm Gray**  
Da. Z njimi gre tudi stara knjiga, ne glede na to, kaj bo naredila z mojo licenco.
Začel je stegovati roko. Gib je očitno večkrat vadil in opustil, ustavil pa se je na pol poti. Ona roke ni niti pogledala.

**Anselm Gray**  
Dvorišče in opremo sem zastavil za jamstvo, jamstvo pa ostane odprto družinam ne glede na ugotovitve preiskave. Nič od tega mi ničesar ne kupi. Obnovil bom po načrtu, ki ga boste videli pred okrožjem, in ko boste prečkali, me ne bo na gradbišču.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Ko bom prečkala, vas ne bo. Kdaj bo to, bom odločila jaz.

scenes.title: Klop ob južnem temelju
paragraphs: *Južni temelj, tarnvalska brv · torek, 15:30*
Ilse Marchetti je sedela, kakor sedijo spajalci, roke pa so bile zaposlene z ničimer. Iz obtolčene termovke je nalila skodelico in jo brez vprašanja podala Illuminari.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Recept mojega brata. Leča in vse, kar je bilo v predalu.
Bila je divje preslana in je imela rahel okus po katranu, Illuminara pa je na svoje precejšnje presenečenje ugotovila, da je navdušena.

**Illuminara**  
To je najslabša juha, ki mi jo je kdo kdaj dal.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Tako zelo bi ga razveselilo.

Ilse se je enkrat zasmejala, kratko in osuplo, nato pa ji je osuplost spet zaprla obraz. Illuminara ni rekla nič in je popila do konca. Veter se je dvignil po soteski in preživeli glavni kabel je začel peti čisti A z nečim rahlo napačnim pod njim.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Matteo je žvižgal napačni del. Vsakič, ko je prečkal.

**Illuminara**  
Kaj bi povedal resničen zapis?

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Da so bila obešala razpokana eno leto in da je človek to vedel. Da je Matteo Marchetti, osemintrideset let, monter, hodil na nočno izmeno v konzervarno. Jun Abara. Corrie Vance. Desmond Thule. Da se niso *izgubili v nesreči*. Njihova imena na novem razponu, vklesana dovolj globoko, da jih bo mogoče prebrati iz vode.

**Illuminara**  
In česa ne boste storili?

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Ne bom mu segla v roko. Ne bom sedela na odru, medtem ko vikar govori o miru. V mestni hiši ne bom napisala, da mu odpuščam, ker klinika potrebuje cesto.

**Illuminara**  
Boste podpisali za most?
Ilsin palec se je ustavil na pokrovu termovke.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Nihče me ni prosil, naj podpišem za most. Prosili so me, naj podpišem zanj.
Illuminara je sedela povsem pri miru. Tako je slišala stvari, ki so prerazporedile sobo.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Most si želim vse od tiste noči. Takšnega, ki ga lahko prečka otrok. Če bi na strani pisalo, da se z njim strinjam, da bodo na njem imena in da bo zgrajen tako, kot rečem, bi ga v ponedeljek zjutraj podpisala z nalivnim peresom.

**Illuminara**  
Mislim, da stavek o odpuščanju ni prišel iz Sklada. Rada bi ugotovila, čigav je bil. Ne morem vam obljubiti dokumenta.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Ne prosim vas zanj. Prosim vas, da mojega ne županji ne odnesete kot da.

**Illuminara**  
Odnesla ga bom natanko tako, kot ste ga izrekli.

scenes.title: Deveti člen
paragraphs: *Mestna hiša Tarn Vale · sreda, 11:00*

Programski uradnik Sklada je bil glas iz zvočnika v sejni sobi, glas pa je dolgo poklicno pot preživel previdno. Calder Voss je ponoči na Illuminarino prošnjo poslal Prilogo B. Cosima Arden jo je natisnila dvakrat in ni podčrtala ničesar, kar je bilo za županjo dejanje samoobvladovanja.

**Illuminara**  
Gospod Voss, bi na glas prebrali opredelitev Prizadete stranke, nato Dogovora in nato določilo devet ena?

**Calder Voss**  
*Prizadeta stranka pomeni najbližjega svojca vsakega človeka, ki je umrl ob porušitvi in še živi v dolini, ter vsakega lastnika zemljišča, čez katero potekajo Dela. Dogovor je sklenjen šele, ko ga podpiše vsaka Prizadeta stranka.* Nato: *Dogovor pomeni soglasje vsake Prizadete stranke k Delom pod navedenimi pogoji.* In devet ena: *Če katera koli Prizadeta stranka v štiriindvajsetih mesecih po sklenitvi prekliče Dogovor, je treba Nepovratna sredstva vrniti v celoti.*

**Illuminara**  
Zakaj prav vsak?

**Calder Voss**  
Ker Sklad ne bo gradil čez trajajoči ugovor. Devet ena je zaščita denarja pred podpisom, ki ga nihče ni mislil resno.

**Illuminara**  
Ali Sklad kjer koli zahteva odpuščanje?

**Calder Voss**  
Ne. Ta stavek je besedilo prijavitelja. Mi zahtevamo soglasje k Delom.
Ardenino pisalo se je ustavilo. Nihče ni izrekel Fennovega imena.

**Calder Voss**  
Odkrit bom, gospodična Illuminara. Zabeleženo nestrinjanje znotraj dogovora je opozorilna zastavica. Moj odbor zastavice bere.

**Illuminara**  
Česa so se bali, ko so pisali devet ena?

**Calder Voss**  
Hollin Weira. Oče je podpisal na otvoritveni slovesnosti, medtem ko so ga gledali sošolci njegove hčere. Osem mesecev pozneje je časopisu povedal, da tega nikoli ni mislil. Temelji so bili uliti. Nepovratna sredstva smo izterjali nazaj in most je tri leta ostal napol zgrajen.

**Illuminara**  
Podpis, ki ga bo človek najverjetneje preklical, je torej tisti, ki ga je dal, ker je okoli njega stalo vse mesto. Najmanj verjetno pa bo preklical stran, ki jo je napisal sam in na kateri natančno piše, s čim se strinja in s čim ne.

**Calder Voss**  
To je dober argument. Prav natanko to bi rekel tudi nekdo, ki hoče, da se nepovratna sredstva odobrijo.

**Illuminara**  
Res je. Preverite ga ob Hollin Weiru. Vprašajte se, kaj bi tisti oče podpisal, če bi mu stran dovolila obdržati njegov ne.
Na zvezi je nekaj časa šumelo.

**Calder Voss**  
Če je njena stran njen Dogovor, ne more preklicati ničesar drugega kot lastne besede. To lahko predložim odboru. Priloga ena: njeno soglasje k Delom, kot so določena, k načrtu, štirim imenom in javni evidenci pregledov, skupaj z njeno izjavo, da ne odpušča, ohranjeno z njenimi lastnimi besedami, neurejeno, kot del Dogovora. Jutri bom poslal natančno besedilo, da bo prebrala, kaj njena stran postane, preden ga predložim. Odbor glasuje v petek ob petih in glasovanja vam ne bom obljubil. Do petka opoldne potrebujem dvoje: njeno lastnoročno soglasje in načrt z žigom okrožnega inženirja, ne človeka gospoda Graya.

**Cosima Arden**  
Tisti stavek je bil naš. Sklad ga nikoli ni zahteval, jaz pa sem ga pustila, ker ga je bilo lahko prebrati na glas.
Skozi svetovalčev stavek je potegnila eno samo črto in se podpisala ob njej. Nato je z lista, na katerem je bil načrt tedna, prečrtala otvoritveno slovesnost.

scenes.title: Isti nasmeh
paragraphs: *Grayjevo dvorišče, risalnica · četrtek, 19:20*

Gray je po lastni izbiri stal zunaj pred vrati risalnice, na mrazu, s klobukom v rokah. V notranjosti je Ilse razgrnila nove načrte pod svetilko in jih prebrala, kakor je brala žico, od odrezanega konca nazaj.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Ista žica. Isto uho. Isto leto nasmeha, preden popusti.

**Illuminara**  
Kaj bi spremenili?

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Opozorilno nit. Eno svetlo žico, označeno z barvo in položeno zunaj drugih, da se prva razcefra. Uho ovijte z oranžnim tulcem, da bo vsak otrok videl obrabo. Evidenčna knjiga pa gre v stekleno omarico ob začetku mostu, ne v pisarno. Vsak, ki prečka, lahko prebere, kaj je zapadlo.

**Anselm Gray**  
To naročilu žice doda enajst dni, računu pa šest tisočakov.

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Potem jo spojite tukaj. Pet obešal. Vaši posadki bom pokazala način polaganja.

**Anselm Gray**  
Na dvorišču je certificirana žica z del za južni dostop, tovarniška potrdila so v predalu. Dovolj za pet, če nihče ne zapravi niti centimetra. Vse bom vnaprej pokril iz jamstva, še pred nepovratnimi sredstvi. Če Sklad odstopi, je to moje breme.

Ni pogledala skozi vrata. Govorila je načrtom, vodja posadke pa je slišal vsako besedo; do devetih je šest ljudi polagalo žice po tleh risalnice v vzorcu, ki ga je Ilse dvakrat pokazala z lastnimi rokami, tretjič pa ga ni hotela. Pell, okrožni inženir, bo naslednje jutro ob osmih natezno preizkusil spojeni vzorec ter polaganje potrdil ali ne, kakor bo pokazal vzorec. Ilse je Grayu naročila, naj mu to pove.
Illuminara je čez mizo potisnila čist list in pisalo. Obrnila se je, da bi gledala svetilko in ne strani; ni je smela prebrati, dokler ji je ne bi izročili.

Ko je Ilse stran potisnila nazaj, je na njej pisalo: *Anselmu Grayu ne odpuščam. Ni mi treba. Soglašam z mostom, zgrajenim po načrtu, ki sem ga videla, z obešali, ki jih lahko prebere vsak otrok. Vklešite njihova imena: Matteo Marchetti, Jun Abara, Corrie Vance, Desmond Thule. I. Marchetti.*

Poleg nje je Illuminara položila Vossovo besedilo, natisnjeno tisto popoldne. Ilse ga je dvakrat prebrala s prstom pod vrstico: *Priloga ena je lastno besedilo podpisnice in je sestavni del Dogovora. Ni ga dovoljeno povzemati, urejati ali preoblikovati. Njeno soglasje se nanaša na Dela, kot so načrtovana, na štiri imena in javno evidenco pregledov ter na nič drugega.*

**Ilse Marchetti**  
Spremenite *njeno* v *moje*. Sicer pa piše to, kar sem rekla.

**Illuminara**  
Je to vse?

**Ilse Marchetti**  
To je vse. Odnesite svojemu človeku. Moje je. Ne olepšujte ga.

scenes.title: Popuščanje bremena
paragraphs: *Tarnvalska brv, severni razpon · petek, 22:40*

Vossovo sporočilo je županjo doseglo deset minut čez šest: *Odbor je odobril s 5 proti 2, Priloga ena je vključena, kot je napisana. Sredstva se sprostijo ob sklenitvi.* Cosima Arden ga je na dostopu do mostu prebrala dvakrat, nato pa z nenavadno obzirnostjo telefon pospravila v žep in nikomur ni rekla ničesar več.

Načrti z žigom so šli tisto jutro ob enajstih v Sklad, nanje je bila pripeta Ilsina stran, za njo pa Pellov žig na načinu polaganja in list nateznega preizkusa. Grayjeva posadka je od poldneva obešala pet obešal na njegov račun, dobrih šest ur, preden je bil obljubljen en sam cent. Ponoči so stala v delovnih lučeh, vsako s svetlo zunanjo žico in oranžnim tulcem. Illuminara je z dlanjo na glavnem kablu držala severni razpon v višini vozišča. Pell je stal ob ograji z merilnikom na vsakem obešalu in obtežno preglednico na tabli; pred vsemi je županji povedal, da bo most odprl njegov podpis, ne Illuminarina roka.

**Illuminara**  
Spuščala ga bom po eno tono naenkrat. Pokličite vsako obešalo, ko prevzame svoj delež.

Brala je vsako obešalo, ko je oživelo. Sedem je prevzelo breme in odgovorilo. Osem. Devet, novo devet, je brnelo tako jasno, da ga je začutila skozi kabel. Deset. Enajst. Pellovi merilniki in njen glas so se pri vsakem obešalu ujemali do tone natančno, kjer pa se morda ne bi, je upošteval merilnike. Grayjeva posadka je klicala vrednosti, deček s pisalno podlogo pa jih je zapisoval v evidenčno knjigo; ob štirih zjutraj je čez prešla zadnja tona, Illuminara je umaknila roko s kabla in prav nič ni padlo. Pell je podpisal list in ga brez besed izročil županji.

Ob desetih do šestih je Ilse Marchetti prišla k južnemu dostopu v plašču, podobnem odeji, s termovko in brez spremstva. Grayjev tovornjak je bil parkiran sto metrov po cesti navzgor z ugasnjenimi lučmi. Županja je sama umaknila slovesnost s programa. Na obvestilni tabli ob začetku mostu je pisalo samo: *Odprtje ob 06:10 s podpisom okrožnega inženirja. Imena bodo vklesana prihodnji teden.*

Ilse je sama stopila na prvo novo ploščo vozišča. Na sredini razpona se je ustavila, položila roko na oranžni tulec in prebrala s kredo napisana imena na vrhu ograje: štiri imena, ki jih je zidarjev vajenec zapisal z najlepšimi velikimi črkami. Veter se je dvignil po soteski. Glavni kabel je pel svoj A in svojo majhno napako.
Ilse je enkrat zažvižgala napako, pol tona mimo.
Nato je brez obračanja prečkala na severni breg. Illuminara jo je z juga opazovala z zadnjim ostankom juhe in za spremembo ni brala nobene sile, temveč je samo poslušala.

translation_sl.critic_line: Illuminara je odkrila, da je Tarn Vale zamešal soglasje k mostu z odpuščanjem človeku, ki je vedoma odlašal popravila: Ilsin nepopravljeni ne je postal zavezujoči dogovor, neodvisno inženirsko preverjanje je obnovljeni prehod naredilo varen, mesto pa je dobilo most, ne da bi izbrisalo mrtve, presojo preživele ali Grayjevo trajno odgovornost.
